tests.requirement: Phase 5 - Engineering Scenario: Repository Health Check.
tests.scenario: GIVEN an unfamiliar repository, WHEN a developer asks whether an automated analysis can be trusted, THEN the health verdict is SOUND iff zero fabrications and every decline categorized (integrity, not coverage).
tests.expected_result: kind=health; rating=SOUND; frozen before the run; identity/consistency-level checks.

tests.scenario: GIVEN a developer about to change flask.app.Flask.dispatch_request, WHEN they ask 'what verifiably breaks?', THEN CodeTruth returns the verified direct callers and call-reachable set - identity-checked, no guessing.
tests.expected_result: kind=impact_method; target=flask.app.Flask.dispatch_request; direct_callers=['flask.app.Flask.full_dispatch_request']; affected_count=3; frozen before the run; identity/consistency-level checks.

tests.requirement: Phase 5 - Engineering Scenario: Change Impact (Truth Boundary / honest-empty).
tests.scenario: GIVEN a developer about to change flask.app.Flask.send_static_file, WHEN they ask 'what verifiably breaks?', THEN CodeTruth returns the verified direct callers and call-reachable set - identity-checked, no guessing.
tests.expected_result: kind=impact_method; target=flask.app.Flask.send_static_file; direct_callers=[]; affected_count=0; frozen before the run; identity/consistency-level checks.

tests.requirement: Phase 5 - Engineering Scenario: Dead Code Candidates / Technical Debt.
tests.scenario: GIVEN a repository accumulating unused code, WHEN a developer asks 'what looks unused?', THEN CodeTruth returns functions with no inbound internal edge, LABELED as CANDIDATES with an explicit boundary - not a deletion verdict.
tests.expected_result: kind=dead_code; candidate_count=139; frozen before the run; identity/consistency-level checks.

tests.requirement: Phase 5 - Engineering Scenario: Safe Refactoring (class impact).
tests.scenario: GIVEN a developer about to refactor flask.app.Flask, WHEN they ask 'what depends on this class?', THEN CodeTruth returns the in-repo callers of its methods (excluding its own), honestly reporting 0 when callers are internal/dynamic.
tests.expected_result: kind=impact_class; target=flask.app.Flask; external_dependents_count=0; methods_count=30; frozen before the run; identity/consistency-level checks.

tests.requirement: Phase 5 - Engineering Scenario: Change Impact (flagship tool, parity).
tests.scenario: GIVEN a developer running the FLAGSHIP change_impact tool on flask.app.Flask.dispatch_request, WHEN they ask 'what verifiably breaks?', THEN the tool reports exactly the engine's verified answer (parity), with zero guesses.
tests.expected_result: kind=change_impact; target=flask.app.Flask.dispatch_request; direct_callers=['flask.app.Flask.full_dispatch_request']; affected_count=3; frozen before the run; identity/consistency-level checks.

tests.requirement: Phase 5 - Engineering Scenario: Change Impact (flagship tool, Truth Boundary).
tests.scenario: GIVEN a developer running the FLAGSHIP change_impact tool on flask.app.Flask.send_static_file, WHEN they ask 'what verifiably breaks?', THEN the tool reports exactly the engine's verified answer (parity), with zero guesses.
tests.expected_result: kind=change_impact; target=flask.app.Flask.send_static_file; direct_callers=[]; affected_count=0; frozen before the run; identity/consistency-level checks.
